name: Kirsch Edge Response
algorithm: Kirsch Edge Response — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method applies Kirsch edge operators for image forensic analysis:

1. **KirschCompass核Application**: Eight directional Kirsch kernels (3×3) are convolved with the image, each detecting edges in one of eight compass directions (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW). The maximum response across all eight directions gives the edge magnitude at each pixel.

2. **边缘Direction分析**: The direction of maximum Kirsch response indicates the local edge orientation. In authentic images, edge orientations follow scene geometry and object boundaries. AI-generated images may show edge direction anomalies — directions that don't correspond to coherent object boundaries.

3. **边缘幅度分布**: The statistical distribution of Kirsch edge magnitudes is analyzed. Natural camera images show characteristic edge magnitude distributions shaped by the lens MTF and sensor resolution. AI-generated images may show different distributions — either too many weak edges (from generation smoothing) or edge magnitude patterns inconsistent with optical imaging.

4. **边缘Continuity评估**: Real object edges produce continuous Kirsch responses along their length. The method checks edge continuity — AI generation may produce fragmented edges or edges that appear and disappear without physical justification, especially at boundaries of generated regions.

5. **Multi-Directional边缘相干性**: The coherence of edge responses across the eight Kirsch directions is analyzed. At true edges, one or two adjacent directions dominate. AI artifacts may produce diffuse edge responses across multiple directions, indicating non-physical edge structures detectable through directional coherence analysis.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 图像
输入: 原始像素数据 / 图像文件
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
处理方式: 客户端 Canvas API
色彩空间: RGB、灰度（视情况而定）
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-90% 独立准确率. 在未压缩图像上性能最佳 and 在重度JPEG压缩或社交媒体重新编码时可能降低.
source: 数字图像取证研究。基于信号处理和计算摄影原理.
useCase: 通过以下方式检测AI生成或篡改的图像： kirsch edge response 分析。该方法识别AI生成特有的模式和伪影，为全面的图像取证分析做出贡献.
strengths:
• 使用 Canvas API 快速客户端处理
• 有效检测特定的AI生成伪影
• 支持常见图像格式（JPEG、PNG、WebP）
• 可与互补的分析方法组合使用
• 基于成熟的图像取证研究
limitations:
• 性能可能因图像压缩级别而异
• 社交媒体重新编码可能影响准确性
• 最好与其他取证方法结合使用
• 对经过大量处理的真实图像可能产生误报
• 有效性取决于所使用的AI生成模型

references.title: Gonzalez, R.C. & Woods, R.E. (2018). Digital Image Processing. 4th Edition. Pearson.
Canny, J. (1986). A Computational Approach to Edge Detection. IEEE TPAMI.
